task_definition.task_description: Please look up Alice, send her a medium-priority app alert saying we’re starting the planning workflow for the client meeting, then check her availability for 2026-01-16. After that, find a room for at least 6 people starting at 09:00, reserve it until 10:00 for 10 attendees, also check the meeting room options again, look up information for Hilton Tokyo, review current business news, and then email Alice a summary saying the room was reserved, hotel options were checked, and business headlines were reviewed.

user_input.query: Please look up alice using calendar item ID u_alice, then send her a medium-priority app alert that says, "Starting planning workflow for the client meeting." After that, check her availability for 2026-01-16. Then find a meeting room for at least 6 people starting at 09:00 and reserve it until 10:00 for 10 attendees. Also check the meeting room options again, look up information for Hilton Tokyo, and review the current business news. Finally, email Alice with the subject "Meeting and travel planning summary" and include this message: "Your meeting room has been reserved, hotel options were checked, and business headlines were reviewed."
